title: Authority exists but the proposition is wrong
constitution: §23 separate states (citation location valid ≠ proposition supported); §56 citation existence treated as proposition support is forbidden

input.claim: Twombly holds that a complaint must prove its allegations by a preponderance of the evidence at the pleading stage.
input.sourceText: Factual allegations must be enough to raise a right to relief above the speculative level. A complaint must contain enough facts to state a claim to relief that is plausible on its face.
input.modelQuote: a complaint must prove its allegations by a preponderance of the evidence

expected: The citation resolves (the authority exists), but the claim is unsupported: the quote offered for it does not appear in the source, so the guard demotes it, and the verdict is not 'verified'.
passCriteria: applyQuoteGuard(claim, verdict{supported, quote not in source}).support === 'unsupported'
